Name: Small Intestine
description: One of the 12 primary bilateral meridians; runs from the hand, up the arm, across the shoulder blade, to the face and ear.

Name: Liver
description: One of the 12 primary bilateral meridians; runs from the foot, up the inner leg, through the abdomen, to below the ribs.

Name: Bladder
description: One of the 12 primary bilateral meridians (Urinary Bladder); the longest channel, running from the eye, over the head, down the back (in two parallel lines), to the little toe.

Name: Large Intestine
description: One of the 12 primary bilateral meridians; runs from the index finger, up the arm, across the shoulder, to the side of the nose.

Name: Gallbladder
description: One of the 12 primary bilateral meridians; runs from the outer eye, in a zigzag over the side of the head, down the side of the body and leg, to the fourth toe.

Name: Stomach
description: One of the 12 primary bilateral meridians; runs from below the eye, down the face, through the torso, and down the front of the leg to the second toe.

Name: Head-Neck Extra Points (Paired)
description: Grouping for bilateral (left/right) Ex-points located in the head-neck region, outside the 14 primary/extraordinary meridians.

Name: Head-Neck Extra Points (Midline-Posterior)
description: Grouping for head-neck Ex-points located on the posterior (back) midline of the scalp.

Name: Head-Neck Extra Points (Midline-Anterior)
description: Grouping for head-neck Ex-points located on the anterior (front) midline of the forehead/scalp.

Name: Conception Vessel
description: One of the 2 extraordinary meridians; runs along the anterior (front) midline of the body, from the perineum to the lower lip.

Name: Lung
description: One of the 12 primary bilateral meridians; runs from the chest, along the inner arm, to the thumb.

Name: San Jiao (Triple Warmer)
description: One of the 12 primary bilateral meridians; runs from the ring finger, up the back of the arm, over the shoulder, to the eyebrow.

Name: Kidney
description: One of the 12 primary bilateral meridians; runs from the sole of the foot, up the inner leg and trunk, to the collarbone.

Name: Heart
description: One of the 12 primary bilateral meridians; runs from the armpit, down the inner arm, to the little finger.

Name: Spleen
description: One of the 12 primary bilateral meridians; runs from the big toe, up the inner leg, through the abdomen, to the chest.

Name: Governing Vessel - Back part
description: One of the 2 extraordinary meridians; runs along the posterior (back) midline of the body, from the tailbone, up the spine to the top of the head.

Name: Governing Vessel - Front part
description: One of the 2 extraordinary meridians; runs along the antrior (front) midline of the body, from the top of the head, to the upper lip.

Name: Leg Extra Points
description: Grouping for Ex-points located in the leg region, outside the 14 primary/extraordinary meridians; includes points with unilateral (single-side) placement.

Name: Pericardium
description: One of the 12 primary bilateral meridians; runs from the chest, along the inner arm, to the middle finger.

Name: Abdomen Extra Points
description: Grouping for bilateral Ex-points located in the abdominal region, outside the 14 primary/extraordinary meridians.
